slides.text: 5 AI tools I actually use, one tip for each
slides.sub: No courses, no hype. These are open on my computer right now.
Talk instead of type, in every app, and it strips your ums on its own. THE TIP: use it on your longest stuff first, long emails and long prompts. That's where you feel it day one.
Dump in your PDFs, notes, and links, then ask questions it answers from YOUR sources only. THE TIP: hit the audio overview button and it turns your documents into a podcast for the drive home.
Clones your voice from about a minute of audio. THE TIP: read naturally when you record it, like you're talking to a friend. An announcer voice clone sounds like an announcer forever.
Research that shows its sources. THE TIP: don't just ask, tell it to compare and cite. Give me both sides with sources beats a confident answer you can't check.
One tap auto captions on any video. THE TIP: captions on everything you post, most people watch on mute, and a video they can't read is a video they skip.
